### Raw observations

- Members used: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]; ensembles present: ['A'].
- Single mean vs DE A: acc 0.9035 -> 0.9273, ECE 0.0302 -> 0.0164, NLL 0.2968 -> 0.2232, Brier 0.1420 -> 0.1103.
- Overconfidence gap (mean conf - acc): single 0.0301, DE -0.0164.
- RAPS re-split mean: DE A coverage 0.8998, size 1.197; single-member mean size 1.190.
- Non-randomized APS (score<=qhat rule) re-split mean, DE A: size 5.326, coverage 0.9003, empty-set fraction 0.0994.
- OOD AUROC (entropy / MI / MSP / RAPS size), DE A: 0.9345 / 0.8639 / 0.9229 / 0.8910; single mean entropy 0.9127, MSP 0.9024.
- SVHN mean confidence: single 0.6593, DE 0.5622; fraction conf>0.9: single 0.1452, DE 0.0308.
- Member accuracy range: 0.8979-0.9077.
- Ablation NLL (mean over subsets): M=1 0.2968, M=2 0.2488, M=5 0.2232.
- Ablation ECE is lowest at M=2 (0.0084) and rises to 0.0164 at M=5 (ensemble becomes under-confident: mean conf < acc).
- RAPS set size: DE A 1.172 vs single mean 1.173 (fixed split; Δ bootstrap CI in the significance table).
- Top confused pair (DE A): cat -> dog, 109 test images.
- Best selective-prediction score for DE A by AURC: msp.
